annotations.title: Equipment makers and product families (Wai checked catalogue)

description: Example product families of energy equipment from several makers (European, US and Chinese): PV modules, PV inverters, BESS containers and PCS, wind turbines, electrolysers, power and dry-type transformers, MV switchgear / RMU, HV breakers and disconnectors, UPS, diesel generator sets. Each entry has only the ratings the maker's own page or datasheet states, its link and the date checked - no prices, no single brand pushed. Call with class (see class_list) or words (maker, family, rating). Suited to the equipment / vendor part of a project report. Answer with the returned numbers, not an estimate made before the call. Typical questions: "Makers and product families of utility-scale PV modules above 600 W, with ratings from their own datasheets"; "Makers and product families of string PV inverters 250–350 kW, with ratings from their own datasheets"; "Makers and product families of central PV inverters above 4 MW, with ratings from their own datasheets"; "Makers and product families of BESS containers of 5 MWh, with ratings from their own datasheets".

class.description: class id, e.g. pv_module, wind_turbine, electrolyzer, bess, bess_pcs, pv_inverter, power_transformer, mv_switchgear, hv_breaker

query.description: words: maker, family or rating, e.g. "Huawei", "800 kV", "tracker"
